title: Строгий role contract и восстанавливаемая запись
goal: Исключить типовые ошибки policy, конкурентную потерю обновления и применённый контракт без аудита.
implementation_notes: Contract service enforces descriptor permission and domain policy itself.
Flags require bool; scopes/targets exact types; unknown/unregistered capabilities rejected.
Use process-safe lock/CAS around hash check and atomic replace.
Use pending audit → atomic write → applied audit; failure remains detectable and reconcilable.
Reconciliation command is idempotent, dry-run capable and never exposes contract secrets.
Rollback is a new authorized previewed change from stored normalized snapshot.
acceptance_checks: String false, unknown capability and incomplete role rejected.
Actor without required permission rejected by direct service call.
Two same-base concurrent writers yield one success and one stale conflict.
Fault injection before/after atomic replace yields recoverable status.
Reconcile dry-run reports and apply repairs only known incomplete state.
Rollback passes authorization, preview and audit.
independent_review: Fault-injection and concurrency review; reproduce first inconsistent transition.
